use PhpCsFixer\AbstractFixer;

 * @author Pol Dellaiera <pol.dellaiera@protonmail.com>
 */
final class ConstantCaseFixer extends AbstractFixer implements ConfigurableFixerInterface
{
    /**
     * Hold the function that will be used to convert the constants.
     *
     * @var callable
     */
    private $fixFunction;

    public function configure(array $configuration): void
    {
        parent::configure($configuration);

        if ('lower' === $this->configuration['case']) {
            $this->fixFunction = static fn (string $content): string => strtolower($content);
        }

        if ('upper' === $this->configuration['case']) {
            $this->fixFunction = static fn (string $content): string => strtoupper($content);
        }
    }

    public function getDefinition(): FixerDefinitionInterface
    {
        return new FixerDefinition(
            'The PHP constants `true`, `false`, and `null` MUST be written using the correct casing.',
            [
                new CodeSample("<?php\n\$a = FALSE;\n\$b = True;\n\$c = nuLL;\n"),
                new CodeSample("<?php\n\$a = FALSE;\n\$b = True;\n\$c = nuLL;\n", ['case' => 'upper']),
            ]
        );
    }

    public function isCandidate(Tokens $tokens): bool
    {
        return $tokens->isTokenKindFound(T_STRING);
    }

    protected function createConfigurationDefinition(): FixerConfigurationResolverInterface
    {
        return new FixerConfigurationResolver([
            (new FixerOptionBuilder('case', 'Whether to use the `upper` or `lower` case syntax.'))
                ->setAllowedValues(['upper', 'lower'])
                ->setDefault('lower')
                ->getOption(),
        ]);
    }

    protected function applyFix(\SplFileInfo $file, Tokens $tokens): void

        $objectOperatorKinds = [T_OBJECT_OPERATOR];
        if (\defined('T_NULLSAFE_OBJECT_OPERATOR')) {
            $objectOperatorKinds[] = T_NULLSAFE_OBJECT_OPERATOR;

            T_AS,
            T_CLASS,
            T_CONST,
            T_EXTENDS,
            T_IMPLEMENTS,
            T_INSTANCEOF,
            T_INSTEADOF,
            T_INTERFACE,
            T_NEW,
            T_NS_SEPARATOR,
            T_PAAMAYIM_NEKUDOTAYIM,
            T_TRAIT,
            T_USE,
            CT::T_USE_TRAIT,
            CT::T_USE_LAMBDA,
        ];

        foreach ($objectOperatorKinds as $objectOperatorKind) {
            $forbiddenNeighbourKinds[] = $objectOperatorKind;
        }

        $forbiddenNeighbourLookup = [];
        foreach ($forbiddenNeighbourKinds as $forbiddenNeighbourKind) {
            $forbiddenNeighbourLookup[$forbiddenNeighbourKind] = true;
        }

        $skipMeaningfulLookup = [];
        $skipMeaningfulLookup[T_WHITESPACE] = true;
        $skipMeaningfulLookup[T_COMMENT] = true;
        $skipMeaningfulLookup[T_DOC_COMMENT] = true;

        $useUpperCase = false;
        $configuredCase = null;
        if (\is_array($this->configuration)) {
            if (\array_key_exists('case', $this->configuration)) {

            $useUpperCase = true;

            $useUpperCase = false;

            $isFalseConstant = false;
            $isNullConstant = false;

                $isTrueConstant = true;
            } elseif ('false' === $normalizedContent) {
                $isFalseConstant = true;
            } elseif ('null' === $normalizedContent) {
                $isNullConstant = true;

                    $previousCandidateIsEmpty = false;
                    if (!$previousCandidateIsArray) {
                        if ('' === $previousCandidateContent) {
                            $previousCandidateIsEmpty = true;
                        }
                    }

                        $previousCandidateIsIgnorable = false;
                        if ($previousCandidateIsArray) {
                            if (isset($skipMeaningfulLookup[$previousCandidateId])) {

                                    $previousCandidateIsIgnorable = true;
                                } elseif (T_COMMENT === $previousCandidateId) {
                                    $previousCandidateIsIgnorable = true;
                                } elseif (T_DOC_COMMENT === $previousCandidateId) {
                                    $previousCandidateIsIgnorable = true;
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        if (!$previousCandidateIsIgnorable) {
                            $previousIndex = $previousCursor;
                            break;
                        }

                    break;

            $nextCursor = $index;

                    $nextCandidateId = $nextCandidate->getId();
                    $nextCandidateContent = $nextCandidate->getContent();
                    $nextCandidateIsArray = null !== $nextCandidateId;

The fix is complete in `src/Fixer/Casing/ConstantCaseFixer.php`:

**Root cause:** The fixer protected constant *names* only by checking the immediate previous neighbour (`T_CONST` was in the forbidden-neighbour list). With typed constants (`const string NULL = 'null';`), the token before the name is the type (e.g. `T_STRING`), not `T_CONST`, so the name was wrongly treated as a `null`/`true`/`false` literal and recased. Conversely, the type token itself (e.g. `const FALSE FALSE`) was skipped when it directly followed `T_CONST`.

**Fix:**
- Detects a constant-declaration *name*: next meaningful token is `=` and walking backwards (skipping whitespace/comments and type tokens — `T_STRING`, `T_ARRAY`, `T_CALLABLE`, `T_NS_SEPARATOR`, `CT::T_ARRAY_TYPEHINT`, `CT::T_NULLABLE_TYPE`, type alternation/intersection, DNF parentheses, and raw `?|&()` chars) reaches `T_CONST`. Such tokens are never recased.
- Removed `T_CONST` from the forbidden-neighbour list so type tokens directly after `const` now get correctly recased.

**Validation:** the failing FAIL_TO_PASS test now passes; `tests/Fixer/Casing/ConstantCaseFixerTest.php` (69 tests) and the full `tests/Fixer` suite (18593 tests) pass with no failures; 21 manual edge-case checks (enums, DNF types, untyped consts, references, strings) all behave correctly, and the file passes the project's own style check apart from pre-existing flags at HEAD.
